violation_type.title: Nutrition and Food Service - Must not serve identified foods to allergic child (26 TAC §744.2401(i))
violation_type.short_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Must not serve identified foods to allergic child
violation_type.typical_finding: It was found that a peanut m&m was served to a child with a diagnosed food allergy to peanuts.
